svg.title: UV sphere with unique polar vertices and wrapped indexed longitude
svg.desc: A latitude-longitude sphere with twelve longitude slices and six stacks has five interior rings, one north-pole vertex, one south-pole vertex, 62 total indexed positions, 120 consistently wound triangular faces, 180 unique edges, and Euler characteristic two. Each longitude ring closes by reusing index zero modulo twelve, with no duplicate endpoint or collapsed pole ring.
svg.text: One pole is one point, not twelve pretending to be one
Latitude–longitude sphere, 12 slices, 6 stacks; longitude wraps by vertex ID
The pole is a parameter singularity. One shared pole vertex avoids a collapsed latitude ring and degenerate triangles.
